newsitem.title: USA: UniComp files for 2.1 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: UniComp files for 2.1 mln common shares.

text.p: Unicomp Inc filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 2.1 million common shares.

Of the net proceeds, $1.8 million will be used to repay debt and the remainder for working capital and general corporate purposes, including funding of strategic alliances or acquisitions of complimentary businesses, products or technologies.
The company said it has no specific acquisitions currently under consideration or discussion.
The offering will be made through Cruttenden Roth Inc. The underwriter has an over-allotment option for up to 315,000 additional shares.
